name: hackyay-ai-tutor
description: An IDE plugin that intercepts compilation or runtime errors (like segmentation faults or data races). Instead of rewriting the code, it injects an interactive visual memory map directly into the editor pane using Codex inline features. The student must manipulate a graphic flowchart of memory blocks and references to physically "fix" the memory safety violation before the compiler lets them run the code again, turning low-level debugging into a spatial puzzle.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
